description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'EmployeeSalaryDao' for managing EmployeeSalary entities in a Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for saving, deleting, and retrieving employee salary data, utilizing Doctrine ORM query builders and pagination.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for EmployeeSalary Entity, providing methods for CRUD operations and querying salary data with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: saveEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Persist a new or updated EmployeeSalary entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeDirectDebit
methods.description: Remove an EmpDirectDebit entity from the database.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Delete multiple EmployeeSalary records based on employee number and a list of salary IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Retrieve a specific EmployeeSalary record by employee number and salary ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeSalaryIdsByEmpNumber
methods.description: Get IDs of EmployeeSalary records for a specific employee, filtered by given salary IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Retrieve a list of EmployeeSalary entities matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalariesCount
methods.description: Count the number of EmployeeSalary records matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalariesPaginator
methods.description: Create a query with filters and pagination based on search parameters for EmployeeSalary records.
